releaseNotes:
🚀 Shift 1.0.3 Release

• Custom chat themes — per-chat accent colors, bubble colors, and font size
• Group chat management — add members and view group details
• Two-factor authentication (2FA) support with TOTP
• 2FA prompt on auto-login with configurable toggle
• Audio call bandwidth optimization (~2 MB for 30 min)
• 30-minute call duration hard cap
• Backup TCP TURN server for better connectivity
• Bug fixes and stability improvements
